scope: Window attention on screen fixture: 3072 rows, Q32/KV8, HD64, interleaved QKV with sinks, window 64, no causal/group masks.
sampling_caveat: This window capture has no sampling overflow warning. Both campaigns preserve the user clock range rather than locking frequencies through NCU. Exact instruction and memory counters support the hypothesis.

load_warp_requests.formula: valid_pairs*Qheads*HD/32*8 + 2*n, for three Q/K dot passes, V and output reads, plus sink reads

store_warp_requests.formula: valid_pairs*Qheads*HD/32 + n*Qheads*HD/32, each key update plus zero initialization

hypothesis: Clamp the contiguous valid key interval instead of scanning all rows three times. Share Q, cache each unscaled dot once, and accumulate output dimensions in registers with coalesced V loads and one final store. Serial dot, maximum, denominator and output accumulation orders are preserved; the sink is included last in maximum and denominator, as in the scalar kernel.
resource_tradeoff: Candidate adds 780 bytes of dynamic shared memory per CTA and no persistent VRAM. Cached-score division is still repeated across output dimensions, as in adopted R1; candidate instruction counters must quantify that cost against eliminated dot and memory work.
